Add Wilson confidence intervals to JTBD scores

Source: R/scoring.R
add_score_cis.Rd

Augments a scores data frame from get_jtbd_scores() or get_jtbd_scores.comparison() with confidence-interval bounds for each importance, satisfaction, and opportunity column. Because raw scores are top-2-box proportions scaled to 0–10, the imp/sat bounds use the Wilson interval for binomial proportions. Opportunity bounds propagate via the delta method on opp = imp + max(0, imp - sat).

Usage

add_score_cis(scores, n, conf_level = 0.95)

Arguments

scores

A scores data frame with imp.<seg>, sat.<seg>, opp.<seg> columns.

n

Sample size. Either a single integer applied to every segment, or a named integer vector keyed by segment (e.g. c(all = 200, casual = 80)).

conf_level

Confidence level (default 0.95).

Value

The input data frame with new <imp|sat|opp>_lo.<seg>, <imp|sat|opp>_hi.<seg>, and <imp|sat|opp>_se.<seg> columns.

See also

Other scoring: calculate_opportunity_score(), calculate_pop_pct_score(), find_imp_sat_columns(), get_jtbd_scores(), get_jtbd_scores.individual(), get_sample_size(), split_imp_sat_columns()

Examples

data(jtbd_sample)
scores <- get_jtbd_scores(jtbd_sample)
add_score_cis(scores, n = get_sample_size(jtbd_sample))
